rationale: The agent made order-changing writes without explicit user confirmation (policy violation), including modifying an unrelated order (#W9810810). It did not update the shipping address to the NYC address on file as requested, nor handle the watch exchange to a black dial while keeping the leather strap. The final message mentions a refund to a gift card without any supporting tool result indicating a refund was issued. While the agent did locate the user by name and ZIP and changed the laptop model on order #W3730488, the lack of required confirmation, extra unauthorized modification, missing requested actions, and unsupported refund statement mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
